why: No major reviewer or authority tests Qi2 car chargers for heat or sustained speed. Macworld and WIRED appear by name but their pages are about desk chargers or uncooled 15W car mounts. The on-target results are one self-declared research-only comparison, a Gadgeteer roundup without thermal data, and the same affiliate article recycled across four domains that repeats Anker's 50%-in-22-minutes claim while admitting it is untested. A focused page with measured temperatures, sustained wattage, adapter pairing, current prices and a direct pick would stand out.
